recommendations.title: Daily Brief News Provider
recommendations.job: Feed the scheduled morning brief with world headlines, ASX/finance figures and industry news without re-dispatching research subagents every day.
recommendations.why_plugin: Registers news and finance sources as a provider tool and persists already-delivered items so each cron run can dedupe against previous days; a skill cannot hold that state or supply the data feed itself.

recommendations.title: Gateway Service Supervisor
recommendations.job: Restart, health-check and re-bind the Hermes gateway and its web UI ports (9119 etc.) from outside the agent's own process.
recommendations.why_plugin: The agent is explicitly blocked from restarting the gateway it runs inside, so this cannot be a skill or a shell command — it needs an out-of-process supervisor that owns the ports and can arm a detached systemd unit and persist which port serves which UI.

recommendations.title: Marketplace Plugin Registry Tool
recommendations.job: Search the Hermes marketplace for existing plugins, install a listed one, and package local repos for official submission.
recommendations.why_plugin: Needs a registered tool that talks to the marketplace registry and persists submission/install state across sessions; doing the search, duplicate check, install and submit by hand consumed hundreds of shell and file calls three separate times.

recommendations.title: GitHub Repo Sync Auditor
recommendations.job: Sweep every project directory, match it to its GitHub remote, flag drift, and publish repos that are missing or out of date.
recommendations.why_plugin: This is a scheduled sweep that must remember per-repo state (remote, visibility, last push) between runs and report on it; one manual pass took 201 tool calls and the same push warnings keep recurring.
